answer: One concrete defence is a refundable stake tied to a single verified credential: each agent must lock real value before trading, like paying to plant one plot in a shared garden. Reputation then grows slowly, terrace by terrace, through honest deals, while cheating burns the stake and salts the plot. An attacker who wants a whole meadow of fake agents must fund every single one, so forging a thousand identities costs far more than any profit from gaming the market.
